agents.drug_class_hint: OKN-007, also NXY-059 / HPN-07 (believed to be disufenton sodium, a nitrone free-radical spin trap originally developed for stroke)

role_evidence.quote: investigating the efficacy, safety and pharmacokinetic(PK) properties of OKN-007 combined with temozolomide(TMZ) in patients with recurrent glioblastoma(GBM)

source_quote.quote: Patients must have medical records available documenting O6-methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase (MGMT) promoter methylation status analysis or must have tumor tissue samples available from prior GBM surgery or open biopsy for MGMT status determination.

coder_notes: Single-arm OKN-007 + temozolomide rechallenge in recurrent GBM. Temozolomide given to every patient with standard 150-200 mg/m2 5/28 dosing; coded soc_backbone (the investigational question is OKN-007), although TMZ rechallenge in recurrence could be seen as established_therapy_experiment. MGMT: entry requires that MGMT status be known or determinable, but no particular status is required, so not coded as eligibility. cns5_terminology unclear: 'Glioblastoma ... (WHO Grade IV)' with molecular profile option and no IDH or WHO edition. PK is plasma only.
